sources.snippet: Aloha! 🌺 Ornith is a family of self-improving open-source models for agentic tasks. This repo covers both generations: 🐦 Ornith-1.5 (latest) — extends self-scaffolding into a complete end-to-end self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning.
